chunks: From him, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Jabalah, from ʿAlaʾ, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, concerning:
A man wants to attend to a need when the sun declines; should he perform the first prayer at that time? He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first prayer, referring here to salat al-zuhr
key_terms.الْحَاجَةَ: a need or matter requiring attention
key_terms.تَزُولُ: declines from the meridian; marks the beginning of Zuhr time
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray Zuhr at the time of zawal if someone has a need to attend to?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of performing the first prayer, meaning salat al-zuhr, at the time of the sun’s decline when a person has some need to attend to. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no harm in performing it then, indicating permissibility at the beginning of its time.
